column3: Sidecar pairing record for the cancellation-seams note: 7 heading keys, each an en/zh block hash outside code blocks; regenerate with pnpm run verify-translation-pairing --write.

Proposes a required AbortSignal on every tool-reachable async capability so omission fails TypeScript; rejects ambient async-local signals and never-abort defaults; defines a detached-work ownership handoff commit point.
Chinese translation of the cancellation-seams note; full read (65 lines) keeping the seam vocabulary and the English Status line verbatim.
Sidecar pairing record for the domain-KV note: 15 heading keys covering the storage hub, both backends, the domain form, the workspace entity, the reuse audit and the out-of-scope list.

Full design of the domain-KV storage seam (hub plus json and sqlite backends plus domain form) and the workspace entity: 7-clause backend contract, per-domain write serialisation, version-fails-loud, bottom-up recursive delete, per-domain backend routes.
Chinese translation of the domain-KV note; read as head(30)+tail(25) window (329 lines) plus the full heading map and the English original, which supply the body.
Sidecar pairing record for the session-projection note: 15 heading keys including the whole-value rule, the host registry, the tail-page wire block, the client value store and the command lifecycle.

Introduces the host-side projection registry, the whole-value event rule, a generic seq-guarded client value store, the projections block on the history tail page, and durable command/run plus command/done events.
Chinese translation of the session-projection note; read as head(30)+tail(25) window (191 lines) plus the full heading map and the English original.
Sidecar pairing record for the storage-root note: 8 heading keys whose slugs encode the shipped-versus-still-open split and the declared-derived-media decision.
Closes the per-cwd storage-root mismatch and proposes a per-domain recovery reject-or-reset policy driven by a closed three-code damage-class list and a single-shot destroy-and-reopen.
Chinese translation of the storage-root note; full read (62 lines), embedding two long verbatim English quotes of the Cordis and storage rationales.
Sidecar pairing record for the last-activity-index note: 7 heading keys including a /related key for the trailing cross-reference list.

Proposes storing the latest human-prompt time in the Session index under one shared event predicate; rejects mtime ordering as impossible and cites the JSONL never-rewrite invariant that forbids a mutable header field.
Chinese translation of the last-activity-index note; full read (64 lines), matching the English line count exactly.
Sidecar pairing record for the composer-chain-phases note: 6 heading keys.

Replaces one global numeric composer priority with domain-owned ordered phases (interaction before restriction); registration fails loud on an unknown phase; the change is client-only so it costs no tokens and no KV-cache invalidation.
Chinese translation of the composer-chain-phases note; full read (46 lines).
Sidecar pairing record for the session-rebuild plan: 17 heading keys, the only sidecar in the shard with three levels of nesting.

Master plan for LogicalSession, SessionService and SessionStorage: staged so each stage preserves behaviour or names one change; the concrete-class access gate ships as warn and flips to enforce by env var.
Chinese translation of the session-rebuild plan; read as head(30)+tail(25) window (174 lines) plus the full heading map and the English original.
Sidecar pairing record for the capability-protocols note: 14 heading keys covering the five protocols and the overall-architecture mermaid block.

Defines the five session protocols (LogicalSession, SessionService, SessionStorage, SessionProjectionPort, SessionQuery) and the rule that only composition sees concrete providers; targets are explicitly not all implemented in Stage 3.
Chinese translation of the capability-protocols note, one of five that keep the English canonical ## headings while translating the ### headings and body; full read (94 lines).
Sidecar pairing record for the data-compatibility note: 9 heading keys; its /proposal key carries the identical en and zh hash 986dd8097aac4d3d because that section's own text is empty on both sides.

States that the session refactor must not change V3 JSONL bytes, SESSION_FORMAT_VERSION or the startup flow; migration writes a new generation and retains old ones; derived data cannot become recovery authority.
Chinese translation of the data-compatibility note (English ## headings, Chinese ### headings); full read (44 lines).
Sidecar pairing record for the developer-transition note: 9 heading keys; the migration pseudocode is a code block and so is not hashed.
Per-stage developer rules and before/after migration pseudocode for the session refactor; forbids new code from using SessionPersistence or presenting draft PRs as released.
Chinese translation of the developer-transition rules (English ## headings, Chinese ### headings); full read (101 lines) with the pseudocode block reproduced verbatim.
Sidecar pairing record for the session-refactor FAQ: 14 heading keys, one per question; its /proposal key shares the same empty-section constant 986dd8097aac4d3d.
FAQ separating temporary naming from long-term responsibility for the five session abstractions; rejects the name SessionRuntime because the repo reserves Runtime for components that run live work.
Chinese translation of the session-refactor FAQ (English ## headings, Chinese ### headings); full read (63 lines).
Sidecar pairing record for the composer refactor note: 12 heading keys nesting the stage-one invariants and the stage-two ownership and synchronisation subsections.

Two-stage composer refactor: five mechanical responsibility extractions first and behaviour second, with a table stating what stage one does NOT achieve; stage two forbids renames and mechanical cleanup.
Chinese translation of the composer refactor note; read as head(30)+tail(25) window (116 lines) plus the full heading map and the English original.
Sidecar pairing record for the typert metadata note: 10 heading keys; the six paired code examples are excluded from hashing as code blocks.

Replaces committed generated-source metadata with ordinary artifacts; every parameter gets normal and strict codecs from one model so consumers choose policy; input views, parsers and JSON Schemas are independently lazy and cached.
Chinese translation of the typert metadata note (mixed English ## and Chinese ### headings); read as head(30)+tail(25) window (191 lines) plus the full heading map and the English original.
Sidecar pairing record for the migration-redirect note: 7 heading keys, one naming the open completion-milestone decision.
Presents long Session format migration as a typed business redirect on a history read; progress enters neither the session log nor session.control; unknown totals produce no fabricated percentages.
Chinese translation of the migration-redirect note; full read (43 lines).
Sidecar pairing record for the cleanup-lifetimes audit: 13 heading keys, one per P0 finding.

P0 audit of Cordis cleanup-dependency lifetime violations across session persistence, storage and schedule, authorization, SSH and the Windows sandbox; five focused reproductions plus a controlled-promise regression recipe.
Chinese translation of the cleanup-lifetimes audit; read as head(30)+tail(25) window (93 lines) plus the full heading map and the English original.
Sidecar pairing record for the attachment-quarantine note: 6 heading keys.
Quarantines unreadable historical attachments with a durable attachment/quarantine event and deterministic text replacement; recovery happens only after digest and metadata verification.
Chinese translation of the attachment-quarantine note; full read (38 lines).
Sidecar pairing record for the pre-tool-input-rewrite note: 9 heading keys including a bespoke three-readers section key.
Identifies the three readers of pre-execution arguments (assistant/message, tool/call, presentation) and requires a rewrite to be atomic across all three before ToolExecution identity exists.
Chinese translation of the pre-tool-input-rewrite note; full read (53 lines) with the protected-identity argument preserved.
Sidecar pairing record for the recallable-compaction note: 14 heading keys, one per mechanism subsection (stubs, state checkpoint, pass execution, recall tools, cache and cost).

Splits compaction into frozen index stubs plus one mutable state checkpoint so the prefix is system-stubs-state-tail and the cache miss is no longer position-zero; adds history_read and history_search plus an inflation guard.
Chinese translation of the recallable-compaction note; full read (110 lines); the only file in the shard whose Chinese is longer in bytes than its English twin.
Sidecar pairing record for the side-sessions note: 6 heading keys.

Defines a user-driven side session forked at the last completed turn, framed read-only by a plugin-sourced context/message that keeps the system prompt byte-identical so the provider prefix cache survives.
Chinese translation of the side-sessions note; full read (41 lines).
Sidecar pairing record for the task-surface note: 12 heading keys, one per contract section.

Versioned declarative UI model rendered by a normal web plugin: one show_task_surface tool, a docked editable panel, a transactional submit and a durable queued/claiming coordination record, with schema-backed byte and count limits.
Chinese translation of the task-surface note; read as head(30)+tail(25) window (277 lines) plus the full heading map and the English original.
Sidecar pairing record for the mandatory-update API note: 13 heading keys, one per request and response shape; the JSON examples are code blocks and unhashed.
Guest-accessible mandatory-update policy endpoint with a flattened Desktop payload; service failures must not masquerade as success because a success clears an existing block.
Chinese translation of the mandatory-update API note; full read (150 lines); the show_content copy is already Chinese in the English original.
Sidecar pairing record for the update-extensions note: 13 heading keys, one per deferred capability.

Four deferred update capabilities with their qualification tables: .dsk.N independent revisions, stable and nightly channel switching, automatic installation and next-launch installation; replacement after readiness is application coordination, not an updater-library capability.
Chinese translation of the update-extensions note; full read (113 lines).
Sidecar pairing record for the update-policy note: 9 heading keys; the checklist section is anchored by a raw HTML id in the English file.
Umbrella update note plus an unchecked CDN and capacity qualification checklist with real load numbers; automatic discovery is kept but automatic download, installation and restart are not.
Chinese translation of the update-policy note; full read (59 lines) with the checkbox list preserved.
Sidecar pairing record for the pi-extensions bridge note: 13 heading keys; the 15-row gap table is unhashed table content.

Bridge that loads unmodified Pi 1.0.0 extension sources onto DSH extension points, with a six-name tool-argument translation table enforced by a test, ignorable plugin: session records, and a ranked 15-row gap table of DSH mechanisms narrower than Pi's.
Chinese translation of the pi-extensions bridge note; read as head(30)+tail(25) window (142 lines) plus the full heading map and the English original.
Sidecar pairing record for the pi-plugins note: 14 heading keys, one per support level plus the runtime-differences table.

Six-level support ladder for Pi's Chord plugin mechanism with an upstream trigger and DSH work per level, plus a runtime-differences table that is an incidental self-audit of DSH on provider replacement, fault isolation, remote declaration, shared state and runtime loading.
Chinese translation of the pi-plugins note; read as head(30)+tail(25) window (140 lines) plus the full heading map and the English original.
Sidecar pairing record for the api-extractor note: 7 heading keys including a bespoke /why-deferred key.
Deferred proposal for a checked-in per-package public-API report that CI diffs; keeps a Why-deferred section keyed to the repo's unpublished stage.
Chinese translation of the api-extractor note; full read (32 lines).
Sidecar pairing record for the supply-chain note: 7 heading keys including a legacy /plan key.
Four supply-chain checks; the key one reconstructs vendor/ from manifest SHAs plus checked-in patch files so the manifest's claims become verifiable artefacts rather than prose.
Chinese translation of the supply-chain note; full read (35 lines).
Sidecar pairing record for the discover-package-inventory note: 5 keys, with no alternatives-considered key because the note carries the pre-format marker instead.

Make package and gate inventories discoverable from the packages/<group>/<pkg> hierarchy plus manifests with generate-and-check gates; records that the tsconfig path wildcard was reverted because resolving candidates in order dominated source-launch boot.
Chinese translation of the discover-package-inventory note; full read (32 lines), carrying the pre-format marker comment verbatim in English.
Sidecar pairing record for the human-review-maintenance note: 12 heading keys, one per contract section.

Periodic dual-reviewer workflow turning adopted human PR feedback into skill updates: acquisition and adoption-evidence contracts built from two tree diffs, byte-identical executables refused, nonce-tagged untrusted feedback, and a recorded dry run of 426 items yielding 0 candidates.
Chinese translation of the human-review-maintenance note; read as head(30)+tail(25) window (85 lines) plus the full heading map and the English original.
Sidecar pairing record for the packed-session-fixture-migrator note: 6 heading keys.
Removes a temporary fixture-migration CLI while keeping the permanent canonical-layout check; removal is gated on a live open-PR inventory rather than elapsed time.
Chinese translation of the packed-session-fixture-migrator note; full read (38 lines).
Sidecar pairing record for the audience-first documentation note: 16 heading keys, the largest in the shard, nesting five diagnoses under Problem and six sections under Proposal.

Defines brief, intuitive, friendly, accurate and agent-readable as reviewable outcomes with criteria by document job, an entry/detail layer split for generated references, and measured corpus numbers separating generator completeness from reader lookup cost.
Chinese translation of the audience-first documentation note; read as head(30)+tail(25) window (139 lines) plus the full heading map and the English original.
Sidecar pairing record for the office-background-scheduling note: 6 heading keys.

Removes the Office conversion queue's background scheduling (priority, promotion/demotion, speculative eviction, foreground reader reservation) because no production caller submits a background request; refuses to proceed before reconciling with prewarming PR #4064.
Chinese translation of the office-background-scheduling note; full read (40 lines).
Sidecar pairing record for the config-only-HMR note: 6 heading keys.
Narrows DSH HMR to live profile configuration refresh, deleting module replacement and its rollback; refuses to call the removed code unreachable and rejects partial removal.
Chinese translation of the config-only-HMR note; full read (36 lines).
Sidecar pairing record for the provider-only-instruction-reads note: 6 heading keys.

Requires a FileSystem provider throughout instruction discovery and removes the direct-Node path; the plugin may still no-op without a provider while the helpers must refuse, and unavailable candidates cannot imply removal.
Chinese translation of the provider-only-instruction-reads note; full read (37 lines).
Sidecar pairing record for the stream-visibility-pruning note: 6 heading keys.

Removes five unused exported stream visibility queries and their private helpers while retaining the first-token reader that Session Stats and Trajectory use; distinguishes no repository consumer from no ecosystem consumer.
Chinese translation of the stream-visibility-pruning note; full read (35 lines).
Sidecar pairing record for the python-sdk-directional-client note: 6 heading keys.

Removes the Python SDK's unused reverse RPC direction and its queue while keeping an explicit guard so a server request cannot settle an unrelated pending client request; the shared TypeScript transport stays bidirectional.
Chinese translation of the python-sdk-directional-client note; full read (34 lines).
Sidecar pairing record for the app-bin-boot-helpers note: 6 heading keys.
Deletes resolveConfigPath and loadEnv from app-boot production exports, leaving fixture-local .env handling; rejects replacing every use with loadLayeredEnv because the discovery semantics differ.
Chinese translation of the app-bin-boot-helpers note; full read (36 lines).
Sidecar pairing record for the prompt-registry-event note: 6 heading keys.

Retires the system-prompt/change event; makes the ScopedLayers notification callback optional and requires it be omitted rather than supplied as a no-op; the active Remote-delivery note must be amended, not rewritten.
Chinese translation of the prompt-registry-event note; full read (35 lines).
Sidecar pairing record for the shell-env-key-declarations note: 6 heading keys.
Reduces shell-environment contributor declarations to key ownership, removing descriptions and list(); states plainly that this is an API contraction, not unreachable-code removal.
Chinese translation of the shell-env-key-declarations note; full read (34 lines).
Sidecar pairing record for the trim-session-query note: 6 heading keys.
Removes four unused SessionQuery convenience methods plus orphaned types and their generated-metadata entries; keeps filterEvents because its literal substring scan differs from FTS token matching.
Chinese translation of the trim-session-query note; full read (35 lines).
Sidecar pairing record for the deterministic-testing note: 6 heading keys including a legacy /plan key.

Three test-discipline measures: a lint rule banning setTimeout in tests, a universal fixture replaying every session log and asserting deriveMessages() equality, and nightly repeat-and-shuffle race stress where a flake is a bug.
Chinese translation of the deterministic-testing note; full read (35 lines).
Sidecar pairing record for the mutation-testing note: 6 heading keys including a legacy /plan key.

Proposes Stryker mutation testing as the counterweight to a per-file 100% coverage gate, with a ratcheting score threshold and surviving mutants as an agent work-item loop; diagnoses execution-without-assertion under agent-written tests.
Chinese translation of the mutation-testing note; full read (36 lines).
Sidecar pairing record for the typed-event-schemas rejection: 12 heading keys including three nested alternatives keys labelled A, B and C.

Rejected: a runtime schema registry for the event vocabulary, because a plugin cannot declaration-merge a Zod schema; the blast radius is measured and only closed-shape schemastery validation is proposed as the proportionate step.
Chinese translation of the typed-event-schemas rejection; full read (75 lines) with the English Status reason kept verbatim.
Sidecar pairing record for the drop-step-boundaries rejection: 5 heading keys with a bespoke /what-we-give-up key and no alternatives-considered key.

Rejected: dropping the durable step/start and step/end events; step/end is concrete information that says whether a model request finished, crashed or is being repaired without inference from the next event.
Chinese translation of the drop-step-boundaries rejection; full read (32 lines).
Sidecar pairing record for the fold-session-persistence rejection: 5 heading keys with a bespoke /what-we-give-up.
Rejected: folding the persistence Service Definition package into dsh-session; the separate package is the intended role split pre-release because there is no external Consumer ecosystem yet.
Chinese translation of the fold-session-persistence rejection; full read (31 lines).
Sidecar pairing record for the truncate-interrupted-turns rejection: 6 heading keys including /what-we-give-up and /related.

Rejected: truncating interrupted final turns on load; the synthetic-closer machinery invents events, but a crash can lose real work, and the future fix should be an explicit user-facing recovery view.
Chinese translation of the truncate-interrupted-turns rejection; full read (36 lines).
Sidecar pairing record for the prune-skill-registry rejection: 6 heading keys.

Rejected: pruning ctx.skills.register() and unused skill fields, because direct runtime skill registration is an intentional extension path; agent-scoped registrations are excluded from the absence-of-consumer argument.
Chinese translation of the prune-skill-registry rejection; full read (29 lines).
Sidecar pairing record for the fold-compaction-package-split rejection: 6 heading keys.
Rejected: folding the single compaction backend into its service package, because more backends are planned; recall adds a consumer of compaction results, not necessarily another implementation.
Chinese translation of the fold-compaction-package-split rejection; full read (37 lines).
Sidecar pairing record for the builtin-timer-promises rejection: 6 heading keys; the implementation finding that killed it lives in the unhashed English Status line.
Rejected on implementation evidence (PR #679): vitest's fake clock does not intercept node:timers/promises, so the swap trades deterministic fast tests for about ten deleted lines.
Chinese translation of the builtin-timer-promises rejection; full read (37 lines) with the English Status reason kept verbatim.
Sidecar pairing record for the NIH-audit rejection: only 4 heading keys, so the entire roughly 30-verdict catalogue hashes as one block.

Rejected: freezes about thirty negative dependency verdicts from a ten-way NIH audit, each with a concrete reason (wrong execution model, cannot express a needed bound, inverts teardown semantics, breaks the test fakes) so the next audit starts from them.
Chinese translation of the NIH-audit rejection; read as head(30)+tail(25) window (78 lines) plus the full heading map and the English original.
